title: Lost Mary Airplane Mode Mint Nic Film - 2mg/ Strip - 20pk
description: Lost Mary Mint Nicotine Films provide a fresh, cooling nicotine experience in a discreet, vapour-free format. The crisp Mint flavour is ideal for those who enjoy a clean taste and fast satisfaction. Each ultra-thin film contains 2mg of nicotine and dissolves gradually under the lip, delivering a steady release with no smoke, stains or odour. Ideal for busy days, flights or social settings where vaping isn’t an option. Use by placing a film directly on to your tongue and let it dissolve naturally. Dispose of packaging responsibly. How to Use: Nicotine Strips Please Note: Do not chew, suck or swallow these strips – they’re only designed to be placed behind your top lip.
